text:
Maria G: Quick ask — finalizing social plan for the launch next Tue. Need X + LinkedIn threads, 2 creative variants (hero image + 30s clip), and a short ad CTA for paid. Can the content team confirm assets and timing? TL;DR: we need posts scheduled, UTM pattern, and inbound lead routing to SDRs for the webinar signups.

Tyler W: Got it. I can schedule X/LinkedIn slots — what timezone window are we targeting? also need the final copy + creative links.

Maria G: Target window is 9–11am PT on launch day for the main push, with a follow-up thread ~3 hours later. Assets by Fri EOD PT pls.

Asha R: Working on copy now. For benchmark narrative, can we surface the HW latency + cost savings stat in the lead card? e.g., ">3x throughput at 40% lower inferencing cost" — want to validate phrasing with ops.

Jordan K: For inbound leads: route webinar signups to sdr-launch queue, tag utm_campaign=launch_may26 and utm_source=social. Also include a drop-in slack notification to #sales-inbound for hot leads (conversion >= 75%).

Tyler W: Uploaded a schedule stub: https://notion.so/redwood/launch-social-schedule (please comment). Quick copy options below — pick variant A/B and drop final: 

```
Variant A: "Launch day: Scale inference without the bill shock. Join our webinar to see demos + benchmarks. Register: {short.link}"
Variant B: "Faster LLM inference, cheaper scale. Live demo + deep dive — save your seat: {short.link}"
```

Asha R: I prefer Variant B for LinkedIn, Variant A for X thread. Suggest we A/B the ad CTA: "Save your seat" vs "Register now" for paid. :thinking_face: 

Maria G: Good call. Tyler — can you set two paid ad creatives for same audience and swap CTAs? Also make sure creatives have the new logo lockups.

Tyler W: Yep. Will create two ad sets and map CTAs. I'll also attach the scheduling CSV here once done. ETA: tomorrow morning. :thumbsup: 

SamBot: Reminder: asset deadline is 2026-05-22T23:59:00Z per workflow rule.

Jordan K: One more routing detail — webhook to CRM needs field: "source_detail":"launch_social" and "lead_priority":"normal". If landing page shows org size > 500, escalate to priority. I'll add a short spec in the CRM ticket.

Maria G: Perfect. Final checklist: assets (hero + clip + final thumbnails), copy (A & B), schedule (Tyler), UTM + routing (Jordan), ad sets (Tyler), and benchmark phrasing approval (Asha + Eng). Meeting Friday 10am PT to sign off.

Tyler W: I'll post the CSV and ad set links in this thread before Friday.

Asha R: I'll ping eng for benchmark numbers today.

Jordan K: I'll raise the CRM ticket and link it here when created.

Maria G: Thanks team — let's keep comments in the Notion schedule and use this thread only for final confirmations. :rocket:
